content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Trenton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's formal prerequisites—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects, or an associate degree with additional experience. Verify your qualifications before enrolling to avoid delays in application approval.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all scheduled sessions from your location in or near Trenton, interact with active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® Guide framework. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Document your project experience, confirm your education credentials, and pay PMI's exam fee. PMI will audit and approve your application, typically within two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and review sessions to strengthen your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. On exam day, demonstrate your mastery of project-management domains and earn your PMP® credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew. PMI's standard cycle requires 60 PDUs per three-year term. Granite PM Academy and other approved providers offer PDU-eligible courses to keep your credential active and your skills current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
